objective: Create a modern 4:3 About page hero illustration telling the 'why we built it' story through a friendly neighbourhood street with three local shopfronts and glowing discovery pins
audience: Website visitors, community members, and local business owners exploring the Meelte About page
platform: Website About Page Hero Section (1.2fr text / 1fr image grid)
must_include: three small shopfronts (a café, a bakery, and a flower shop)
striped awnings in warm orange and purple
glowing location pins floating above each shopfront
soft lavender background (#F4EFFD) with subtle circular glow behind the scene
plain light lavender background for easy blending
must_avoid: visible text, letters, or words on shopfront signboards
conflict_resolution: Normalized from user draft prompt. Corrected purple token hex from off-brand #6f3fb5 to canonical #743BAA. Injected required primary accent warm orange (#FEA711) into awnings, window trims, and pin accents to satisfy Meelte dominant pair rule (orange + purple must dominate together). Preserved requested 4:3 aspect ratio (1440x1080 target). Enforced overlay_after_generation with zero text to prevent AI lettering defects on shop signs.
